build_siglip2_image_processor: build a SigLIP2 image processor that resizes images to fit max patches and converts them to patch tensors
create_get_image_size_for_max_patches: create a function that computes target image dimensions ensuring the patch grid fits within a maximum number of patches
run_convert_image_to_patches: run conversion of a 3D tensor image into a 2D tensor of flattened patches
